verdict.rationale: BILL has an official developer platform (v3 API) with docs, webhooks, and an llms.txt found via probe, indicating some AI-native discoverability, but there's no evidence of official language-specific SDKs (Python/JS/etc.) and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404s across all candidate paths, suggesting limited machine-readable/SDK tooling. Missing for 10: published official SDKs in specific languages, a discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger spec, and independent developer corroboration of SDK usage.
